```
'enableSchemaCache' => true,
'schemaCacheDuration' => 3600 * 24,
```

This is a new bug since it did not happen a week or two ago. The bug only occures on command line although the cache and database configs are the same for web. I dont know why this works at all since `apc_store` should return `true` or `false` and not an array. http://de.php.net/apc_store
